title: Whether Copperline renews its Fareline rideshare channel in 2027 at current rates, with the high-use surcharge, or lets it lapse
setting: A fictional Texas vehicle service contract obligor and administrator selling Drive Plus contracts through dealers since 2019 and to a rideshare platform's drivers since April 2026, whose rate manual decides the channel's renewal on the forecast lifetime loss ratio of its next year's sales. The company, its partners, its dealers and its people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
stated_inputs: the rate manual's maximum high-use surcharge
loss ratios to the nearest 5 per cent
dollar figures to the nearest dollar
